note: Boo at the Zoo leads a Halloween-and-harvest weekend — costume swaps, a Sunday fall festival and Please Touch classics.

picks.reason: Philadelphia Zoo's Boo at the Zoo — costumes, treats and animals Saturday morning, included with zoo admission.
Ridley Park Fall Festival — the weekend's best community harvest fair, Sunday midday.
Free Craft-tober science-and-crafts morning at the Science History Institute, Saturday at 10.
Free Halloween costume exchange all weekend — swap a costume before the 31st instead of buying one.
Halloween dance party Saturday afternoon in Media — seasonal, free and built for kids.
Free carousel rides at Please Touch Museum, Sunday from 10am.
Fall Harvest Bowling at Please Touch — a Sunday-afternoon seasonal send-off indoors.
